motionSource: Adobe Mixamo goalkeeper diving save and medium, low, high catches
animationLicense: Adobe Mixamo terms; embedded app use
runtime: Retargeted captures sampled on a single clock, catch-height blending and bounded two-joint arm IK
environment: Original procedural training ground, turf, goal, net, stands and lighting
limitations: Low/high lateral dives adapt one captured dive using bounded vertical root movement; dedicated captures remain a quality improvement.
Deterministic virtual shot sandbox, no live ball tracking.
Glove, body and foot contacts use swept proxy volumes; no deforming glove simulation.
Net uses local damped-spring contacts and procedural ripples, not a full cloth solver.
